svg.text: Bound Coverage Atlas: phase and energy remain separate
The lossless LC trajectory reports timing displacement and stored-energy drift as different engineering quantities.
SOURCE benchmarks/cases/lc_long.json · INPUT SHA-256 5af8aea635c93ea3 · METHOD ab2 · NOMINAL STEP 1.6557647e-06 s · ACCEPTED POINTS 1201
A small energy error does not imply a small phase error, and the reverse is also not guaranteed.
